name: oof-train-source-centroid-polar-PCA64-feasibility
status: Amended frozen review before polar code, source-prediction extraction or true-psi read

amendment.reason: Remove a truth-conditioned inference fallback. Multiple true-ray intersections now use the fixed outermost positive radius as a supervised star-envelope target, with all geometry error measured against the original true contour. Only source/output-detectable faults can cause source fallback; source-origin outside true or a missing/ambiguous true ray is a hard representation failure. No ψ was read and no model was fitted under the prior draft.

question: Does an input-only predicted-LCFS centroid yield a viable single polar chart of true scorer contours, and can one fixed log-radius PCA64 preserve held TRAIN geometry while guaranteeing simple physical contours?

prior_evidence.true_centroid_rays: results/direct_contour_star_20260923.json: 4 genuinely multi-intersection rays on 4 of 300 first-sample TRAIN frames, despite 153596/153600 unique rays. This does not establish viability around a predicted origin.
prior_evidence.true_o_point_rays: results/direct_contour_opoint_20260923.json: 9 genuinely multi-intersection rays on 9 of the same 300 frames.
prior_evidence.physical_PCA64: results/direct_contour_pca_20260923.json: held TRAIN median/p95 0.094/0.233 minimum grid cells but 1/300 reconstructed polygon was non-simple; fixed mean-line repair exceeded the half-cell limit.
prior_evidence.direct_learner_negative: results/direct_full_contour_stage2_20260923.json: direct 1024-coordinate MLP produced valid polygons but worsened native selection score by 0.000273. Passing a polar representation gate alone would not establish input-only learnability.

sample_and_access.first100: Exactly the first 100 fold0 OOF filenames that also belong to the original compact TRAIN set and have at least three full EFIT frames in already frozen input-only B10 offsets. Their full-frame total is 21667. They are the prior pilot's first100 eligible names, but this new predicted-origin chart is independent of the old true-centroid gate.
sample_and_access.unused_middle100: The next 100 eligible fold0 OOF original-TRAIN names are intentionally unused and separate the PCA fit from the third-sample representation check.
sample_and_access.third100: Exactly eligible positions 200..299 in the same frozen OOF/original-TRAIN name order, disjoint from the first100 and unused middle100. Their full-frame total is 22567. The ordered names, per-shot input parquet size/SHA, full-frame counts and exact three indices are recorded in the selection manifest before any new true-psi read.
sample_and_access.fixed_frames: Each of the 200 named shots contributes exactly floor(q*(n-1)+0.5) for q=0.1,0.5,0.9, with 300 frames in each sample. Verify efit_times count and monotonicity against the frozen input-only metadata and all source parquet SHA values before selecting the frames. No frame is chosen for its geometry.
sample_and_access.role_proof: All selected filenames are OOF from the fold0 base and belong to the original compact TRAIN set. The last200 validation gate, original salt-0 evaluation tail70 and public/private test shots have zero overlap. Only these 200 TRAIN-shot source inputs and selected true psi maps may be read; do not read validation/gate/tail labels or stored efit_lcfs polygons.

frozen_geometry.source_origin: Predict fold0 base psi from a target-stripped input row and extract its scorer-native 512-point physical LCFS. Compute the signed-shoelace physical centroid of this SOURCE contour, requiring simple nondegenerate CCW source polygon. This input-only centroid is the sole ray origin for both first and third samples. The true contour centroid is measured afterward only for source-to-true origin displacement; it never defines a chart or inference feature.
frozen_geometry.truth: Read efit_psirz only on the three frozen frames per selected TRAIN shot, and extract scorer-native 512-point true physical LCFS on the identical DIII-D R/Z grid/mask. Verify finite, simple and nondegenerate true polygons; a missing true contour is an explicit hard feasibility failure, not a skipped row. Never use stored target LCFS columns.
frozen_geometry.rays: For j=0..511, theta_j=2*pi*(j+0.5)/512 from +R. Use the exact prior star-gate physical line/segment intersection equations: unit ray, parallel if |cross(d,segment)|<=1e-12*segment_length, collinear physical ambiguity at tau=1e-4*min(dR,dZ), accept positive radius>tau and segment parameter within tau/segment_length of [0,1], deduplicate only shared-vertex radii within tau. A source origin must be strictly inside the true polygon and farther than tau from every true segment. For every ray with one or more distinct positive hits, choose the OUTERMOST positive radius as its single supervised star-envelope target; count rays with multiple hits by shot/frame/angle and retain their inner-hit gaps. This fixed target construction is independent of any predicted result. A zero-hit ray, outside/on-boundary true origin or collinear ambiguity is a hard representation failure, never an input-only fallback.
frozen_geometry.source_fallback: An exact source-contour fallback may be selected only from SOURCE-only evidence: a finite source LCFS polygon exists but its own centroid is outside/on its own contour, or an already reconstructed candidate polygon is nonfinite/non-simple/out-of-grid. Count each reason. If source LCFS itself is unavailable, fail because the fallback contour cannot be formed. True-ray multiplicity NEVER triggers fallback; it changes the fixed supervised outer-envelope radius and remains charged by Hausdorff against true LCFS. No truth-derived origin, nearest valid chart, ray repair or shot skip is permitted.
frozen_geometry.first_gate: The 300 first-sample frames must have at most 6 explicit source-only contour fallbacks (<=2%) and ZERO hard true-representation failures: source origin outside/on true polygon, true zero-hit ray or true collinear ambiguity. Count all multi-hit true rays/frames but represent them by their fixed outermost targets; measure uncompressed star-envelope Hausdorff against the ORIGINAL true contour, separately on multi-hit frames, before PCA. Record source↔true centroid displacement, first pathological shot/frame/angle and each fallback/hard reason. If either hard failures occur or >6 source-only fallbacks, STOP before PCA or third-sample true-psi read.
frozen_geometry.positive_radius: For every valid first-sample frame, retain the 512 outermost true-contour radii from the fixed source origin and store log(radius/1 metre) in float64. A finite strictly positive radius is required. The reconstructed contour uses the SAME source origin and exp(log-radius) on the SAME 512 fixed angular rays. Positive radii and ordered rays must yield a finite simple physical polygon; check explicitly rather than assuming the discrete polygon is always valid.

fixed_PCA64_and_held_gate.fit: Only if first_gate passes, fit ONE scikit-learn PCA(n_components=64, svd_solver='full', whiten=False, random_state=0) on log-radius vectors of every viable first-sample frame. Fallback frames are excluded from the basis with their identities/counts declared, never silently imputed; at least 294 fit vectors remain. PCA coordinate means/components are learned from this first sample only. No rank, ray count, origin or normalization sweep.
fixed_PCA64_and_held_gate.third_sample: Read the exact third100 TRAIN shots only after the first gate and frozen PCA fit. Build source-origin outer-envelope log-radius targets by the SAME rule; project and inverse-transform through the fixed PCA64, exponentiate, and construct physical 512-point polygons. Multiple true intersections are never a fallback trigger. A source-only invalid centroid or reconstructed output invalidity may trigger the explicit exact-source fallback and remains included in every quality statistic. Missing true LCFS, source origin outside/on true LCFS, true zero-hit ray or true collinear ambiguity is a hard representation failure, never omitted or repaired. Do not fit PCA on any third-sample vector.
fixed_PCA64_and_held_gate.geometry_metrics: On all 300 third-sample frames including source-only fallbacks, report scorer-native symmetric physical Hausdorff against the ORIGINAL true LCFS, median/p95/max divided by the minimum physical DIII-D grid step; if a hard true-representation failure occurs, report the hard-failure identities and mark the all-frame gate failed rather than computing an optimistic selected-frame summary. Count simple/in-grid accepted reconstructions, explicit fallback frames/reasons, multi-hit true-ray frames and their separate star-envelope/PCA Hausdorff, and native source-contour Hausdorff as a control. Report per-frame source-to-true centroid displacement in metres. For local/X-point-like detail, report directed nearest-contour error on the bottom and top 10% of TRUE contour vertices by Z and the highest-curvature 5% of TRUE vertices, plus the physical coordinates/index of the worst directed and symmetric-Hausdorff point. These are proxies only: the scorer does not provide a reliable true X-point coordinate.
fixed_PCA64_and_held_gate.gate: Pass only if there are ZERO hard true-representation failures, the all-300 median Hausdorff <=0.25 minimum grid cell, p95 <=0.5 cell, source-only fallbacks <=6/300 (2%), and every accepted reconstructed contour is finite, simple and within the physical grid. A source fallback that is in-grid/simple still counts in Hausdorff; multi-hit true-ray frames are represented by the outer star envelope and their actual contour error is never hidden. Do not relax rank, thresholds or fallback semantics after seeing the first or third sample.
fixed_PCA64_and_held_gate.no_learner_or_score: This is a representation feasibility gate only. Even a pass does not authorize full-target extraction, a contour learner, native validation/evaluation scoring, old-ensemble integration, public prediction or submission. A separate learner protocol would be required.

cost_estimate: The old frozen first100/300 scorer-contour extraction took seconds, while 512 rays x 512 segments x 600 frames is about 157 million vectorized intersection pairs; source plus truth LCFS extraction doubles earlier work. Budget under 3 minutes CPU4 and below 2 GB incremental memory for the first gate; conditional PCA and third-sample gate another 1-3 minutes. Record actual prep/source/true/ray/PCA/Hausdorff stages, per-frame failures and cache bytes. No GPU fit.
uncertainty: A polar chart may remove contour vertex-index discontinuity but supplies no new input information. The earlier direct512 learner already returned valid polygons and lost native score. The first gate tests topology; the second tests geometric representation on disjoint TRAIN shots. Neither predicts a leaderboard gain or permits inference use of any true centroid or true contour.
